svg.text: Current borders vs US State Department LSIB 11.4
Local WGS84 AEQD metres. Each row uses identical extent and equal X/Y scale in every panel. Offline vector plot; not an app screenshot.
Blue: current/selected history. Red: archived LSIB. Green dashed: diagnostic reproduction of the existing 0.0004-degree LSIB rule.
219.55 km; 17 vertices; 0.077 vertices/km | LSIB 1.239/km; sampled median 672 m; P95 949 m
48.89 km; 20 vertices; 0.409 vertices/km | LSIB 6.846/km; sampled median 336 m; P95 805 m
Source differences include alignment, edition and political attribution. Distances are not legal accuracy or a recovered simplification tolerance.
